create_SimpleCamera: create a SimpleCamera instance with configs to interface with a Realsense camera on the locobot
create_LoCoBotCamera: create a LoCoBotCamera instance with configs to control the camera pan and tilt joints
get_current_pcd: get the current point cloud from the camera with optional camera or base frame coordinates
set_pan_tilt: set the camera pan and tilt joint angles to specified values with optional wait
get_pix_3dpt: get the 3D coordinates of specific pixel rows and columns from the depth image
